atlas.label: Atlas
atlas.rationale: Policy-aware Atlas formulation; unsupported frozen hosts remain blocked.

bcap.label: BCap
bcap.rationale: Frozen BCap penalty with its declared K3P optimizer and training law.

e22.label: E22
e22.rationale: Policy-aware E22 formulation; unsupported frozen hosts remain blocked.

k3p-no-a2.label: K3P without A2
k3p-no-a2.rationale: Removing A2 is a structural ablation.

k3p-no-anchor.label: K3P without critic anchor
k3p-no-anchor.rationale: Removing the critic anchor is a structural ablation, not a tuned K3P configuration.

k3p-no-penalty.label: K3P without critic penalty
k3p-no-penalty.rationale: Removing the critic penalty is a structural ablation.

k3p-no-training-noise.label: K3P without training output noise
k3p-no-training-noise.rationale: Removing training output noise changes the training law and remains a separate technique.

ka2.label: KA2
ka2.rationale: Public KA2 formulation retains its own training mechanism.

r1r2.label: R1/R2
r1r2.rationale: The modern R3GAN Stacked-MNIST training adaptation is the canonical baseline. The older fixed R1/R2 penalty on a K3P recipe remains an explicit alternative; different recorded sources are not ranked against one another.

release07-gan-v3-cloud.label: GAN v3 release 0.7 (cloud)
release07-gan-v3-cloud.rationale: Particle-cloud prior and host law are separate from the learned-MoG family.

release07-gan-v3-mog.label: GAN v3 release 0.7 (MoG)
release07-gan-v3-mog.rationale: The explicit task adaptation is the runnable MoG configuration. The earlier host-incompatible MoG card stays an archived alternative, with its original source and blockers.
